description: Enterprise techniques used by MiniBus, ATT&CK software S9060 (v1.0)
name: MiniBus (S9060)

techniques.comment: [MiniBus](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9060) has leveraged HTTP calls to the C2.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Feb2024)

[MiniBus](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9060) has created persistence through the use of autostart registry keys to include `HKCU\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\OneDriveCoUpdate`.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Feb2024)
[MiniBus](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9060) has been deployed using a launcher, which has been executed via search-order-hijacking (SoH).(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Feb2024)
[MiniBus](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9060) has the ability to download files from the C2.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Feb2024)
[MiniBus](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9060) has the ability to identify running processes.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Feb2024)
[MiniBus](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9060) has the ability to detect security applications.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Feb2024)
[MiniBus](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9060) has the ability to identify processes associated with virtual machine utilities.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Feb2024)
[MiniBus](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9060) has detected processes associated with Virtual Machines to avoid detection.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Feb2024)
